candidates.name: Iran-UAE (Salman-Sharjah) Gas Pipeline
candidates.researcher_notes: MATCHED-EXISTING, not a new row. The 'Iran-UAE (Salman-Sharjah)' export line is the cross-border framing of physical infrastructure GEM already captures. Under the 2001 NIOC-Crescent Petroleum 25-yr contract (Iran's first cross-border Gulf gas export), NIOC built a ~30-inch line to carry Salman-field gas via Sirri Island to Crescent's offshore delivery point at the Mubarak field (Sharjah's UAE offshore concession), whence Crescent's own Mubarak-Sharjah/Hamriyah infrastructure would take it onshore. Gas was test-flowed to Dana Gas' Sharjah facility once in 2010 before leaks forced a halt; commercial supply (due 2005/2008, ~525-600 mmcfd) never began; a tribunal ruled the contract valid + NIOC in breach, awarding Dana Gas/Crescent USD 607.5m (2014 liability, 2021 quantum). The Iranian-side physical pipe = the chain P3950 Salman-Siri Gas Pipeline (Lavan/Salman -> Siri Island, 147km, 30in) + P3951 Siri-Mobarak Gas Pipeline (Siri -> Mobarak, 66km, 30in). 'Mobarak' in P3951 = Crescent's Mubarak field delivery point (Sharjah offshore, near Iranian-administered Abu Musa), so P3951 is the export/handover leg entered in GEM as domestic Iran. Adding a separate 'Salman-Sharjah' row would duplicate this. Matched primary = P3951 (the leg reaching the Mubarak/Crescent delivery point); P3950 is the upstream Salman->Siri leg. Confirmed NOT P3174 (Off-Shore Gas Pipeline is a Gazprom-owned proposed Pakistan-Iran line, 1500km/1000mmcfd) and NOT P3949 (Siri-Asaluyeh, domestic 289km line running the other direction to the mainland gas hub). Corroboration: The National (2011) + Iran International (2021) on contract/test-flow/arbitration; Crescent Petroleum Wikipedia (Mubarak field in Sharjah's UAE concession; NIOC built transport facilities; no supply ever made); offshore-technology.com (147km Salman->Siri subsea line, the source GEM's P3950 RouteNotes already cites). Tier medium: project facts are strongly corroborated by 2+ independent sources, but the exact GEM-row correspondence rests on the Mobarak=Mubarak reading (GEM lists P3951 EndCountryOrArea='Iran'). DATA-QUALITY FLAGS for the status sweep / not this discovery run: (1) P3950 and P3951 are marked 'operating' though the Crescent cross-border export never went commercial (only a 2010 test flow; dormant/dead post-arbitration) - the Salman->Siri->Mubarak export function is not operating; (2) P3951 EndCountryOrArea='Iran' likely understates the cross-border nature (Mubarak delivery point sits in Sharjah's offshore concession/Abu Musa); (3) consider OtherEnglishNames on P3951 e.g. 'Salman-Sharjah / Crescent / Iran-Sharjah gas export pipeline' and a ResearcherNotes note documenting the 2001 Crescent contract + 607.5m arbitration.
